name: Columbia (STS-9)
about: Columbia (STS-9) (1983-116A), a crewed vehicle (OV-102), launched 1983 Nov 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1983 Nov 30), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW17); its coordinates are written from memory
